command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== create dedicated system account =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc
id inventorysvc

echo "== write unit file =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker (os-comparison-worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

echo "== reload, enable, start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-worker
sudo -n systemctl start inventory-worker

sleep 2
echo "== status =="
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker --no-pager
echo "== process owner =="
ps -eo user,pid,cmd | grep os-comparison-worker | grep -v grep
echo "== enabled check =="
